simulation.initialization: Independent draws from the joint stationary nu, not product marginals
simulation.recorded_time: Predecision states, both Beta draws and both posterior means every retained calendar period
simulation.policy_extension: Linear interpolation of alpha=P(product 2 | own reputation, selected); independent Bernoulli choice. This extension does not certify off-grid indifference or optimality.
simulation.product_choice: Independent product uniform compared to own-state alpha; success uses the realized selected product
simulation.random_streams: Five independent streams per path: joint initialization, TS A, TS B, product choice, success
simulation.customer_selection: Independent actual Beta draws for A and B; exactly one seller selected
simulation.uncertainty: 95% Student-t intervals over independent path means, with paths-1 degrees of freedom; time observations are not treated as IID. Few independent paths give imprecise uncertainty estimates, especially with slow mixing.
simulation.interpretation: Finite-path evidence, not a proof of ergodicity or off-grid optimality. Grid stationary F and continuous simulation may differ because of discretization, initialization or slow mixing.

deviations.residual_bound_scope: Finite numerical MDP only; excludes grid and quadrature error
